creativity.reason: Level 1: the only creative activity is marketing content created as a routine business input, and the core business is property management software.

community.reason: Level 2: specific current employee development plus a named philanthropy program and volunteer time off, but no participant or dollar figures show substantial reach.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: employee resource groups with no figures and a multi-lingual resident communication feature, both limited or unmeasured in reach.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 2: a specific software plan aimed at small property management companies, with no disclosed customer count or revenue for that tier.

evidence.activity: Creates industry-related marketing content and collateral as part of routine sales and marketing
evidence.quote: Marketing activities include advertising, online lead generation, lead nurturing, customer and industry events, and the creation of industry-related content and collateral.

creativity.criterion: level 1: creative work used only as a routine business input (marketing content)

evidence.activity: In-person and on-demand learning and development programs for employees
evidence.quote: We conduct in-person trainings and make available on-demand programming that covers a wide range of topics from professional development to real estate industry acumen.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Employee-led Give Back Committee and company-wide paid volunteer time off
evidence.quote: We empower employee volunteerism through our employee-led Give Back Committee and company-wide benefit of eight hours of paid volunteer time off annually.
evidence.indicators: eight hours of paid volunteer time off annually

community.criterion: level 2: specific current volunteering activity, reach (participants, hours volunteered) not disclosed

evidence.activity: Named corporate philanthropy program supporting housing availability through fundraising, volunteering and matching gifts
evidence.quote: Our corporate philanthropy program, “AppFolio Gives Back”, supports housing availability, an ongoing challenge in the real estate industry, through a combination of employee fundraising, team volunteering, and a corporate matching gift program.

community.criterion: level 2: named ongoing community program, but no dollars or people reached disclosed

evidence.activity: Employee-led resource groups and listening forums
evidence.quote: We foster a culture of belonging through employee-led resource groups, open communication, and regular listening forums, where every voice is valued and contributes to shaping our workplace.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > An Inclusive Workplace

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: employee resource groups with no figures

evidence.activity: AI maintenance tool (Realm Maintenance Performer) supports multi-lingual communication with residents
evidence.quote: The tool facilitates real-time, multi-lingual communication with residents and automatically generates prioritized work orders.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Subscription Plans and Services > Maintenance

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: multilingual customer communication feature, reach not disclosed

evidence.activity: Core subscription plan: all-in-one property management software tier aimed at small property management companies
evidence.quote: AppFolio Property Manager Core is generally suited for small property management companies, serving as the basic, comprehensive, all-in-one system of record centered on accounting functionality, and includes access to a limited set of Stack™ integrations.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Our Platform > Subscription Plans and Services

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 2: business software built for small businesses, reach of this plan not disclosed

notes: These items were excluded as traps or general language: 'connect communities', 'community associations' as a property type, the 'educated community' of customers, the FUTURE conference and paid customer training/certification (customer education as marketing or service), Americans with Disabilities Act compliance (regulatory), 'diversified property portfolios', and the Stack marketplace (third-party technology integrations, not a small-business seller marketplace). Cross-cultural coverage is borderline: the Inclusive Workplace paragraph is about 100 words, but the filing has a full human capital section and also describes a multilingual product feature, so it was marked sufficient. Entrepreneurship is a lean 2: the Core plan targets small firms, but the growth strategy emphasizes attracting larger customers and no small-customer counts are given. The 22,096 total customers was not attributed to the Core plan.
